name: DL-T heavy blaster pistol
description: The DL-T heavy blaster pistol was a pistol undergoing tests and should not be available in general public. It is named "DL-T" due to its status as a testing weapon. Its appearance is a DL-44 heavy blaster pistol but has gold color on it. During the Galactic Civil War, these pistols were found used by smugglers.
